tickets.title: Prepare appreciated stock donation analysis
tickets.text: Compare donating cash versus low-basis Paper Otter Robotics shares from the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable brokerage account to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund at Silver Marmot Foundation, including the expected reduction in concentration and the records needed for the transfer.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that appreciated stock donation analysis by March 20, 2024.

tickets.title: Review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots
tickets.text: Review the Paper Otter Robotics stock lots in Nora and Sam Velvetreed's taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody (about $390,000 with an estimated $265,000 embedded long-term gain) to identify the best lots for charitable funding before Nora chooses assets.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots by March 27, 2024.

tickets.title: Address charitable giving timeline before filing package closes
tickets.text: Address the charitable giving timeline for Nora and Sam Velvetreed before CPA Priya Dewspindle's extended 2023 federal return filing package closes, separating which prior charitable records belong in the filing package from current-year planning items.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable giving timeline before the filing package closes by March 25, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain or resolve donor-advised fund contribution receipt
tickets.text: Obtain or resolve the Silver Marmot Foundation contribution confirmation needed to substantiate Nora Velvetreed's deductible donor-advised fund gift to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund; the file currently only includes a bank transfer note for the contribution.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain or resolve the donor-advised fund contribution receipt by March 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile donor-advised fund balance
tickets.text: Reconcile the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund balance at Silver Marmot Foundation (about $48,200 in the portal) against the activity summary Nora downloaded, checking whether pending grants, investment movement, or timing of deposits explains the difference.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to reconcile the donor-advised fund balance by March 29, 2024.

tickets.title: Support pending grant recommendation review
tickets.text: Support Nora Velvetreed's review of the pending grant recommendation to Marzipan Meadow Rural Clinic in the Silver Marmot Foundation donor-advised fund portal, determining whether the foundation needs additional information to move it forward.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to support that pending grant recommendation review by March 18, 2024.

tickets.title: Address charitable plan after family caregiving change
tickets.text: Address Nora Velvetreed's charitable plan after her mother Hazel Velvetreed moved into assisted living, including consideration of a modest annual grant category for eldercare access organizations in Hazel's county.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable plan after that family caregiving change by April 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA-ready charitable documentation packet
tickets.text: Prepare a single packet for CPA Priya Dewspindle that separates Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund contributions, donor-advised fund grants, and any direct charitable gifts so the tax records do not mix deductible and non-deductible documentation.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA-ready charitable documentation packet by April 12, 2024.
